jsonNormalizerRules: strip markdown fences and surrounding prose
remove unknown keys only after preserving raw response
insert defaults only for non-semantic optional fields
normalize enum spelling when mapping is exact
severityMergeRules: latest disposition does not delete original member findings
groupedAuditRepresentation: A group stores groupId, mergeKey, highestSeverity, memberFindings, evidenceRefs, latestDisposition, and sourceArtifacts without deleting original finding records.
generatedTriageRepairBoundary: Mechanical triage and repair templates may prefill finding identity, target file, locator, requirementRef, and checklist items, but semantic disposition and code/spec mutation rationale must remain explicit.
requirementCompliancePrecheckFallback: Obvious no-diff, missing file-map, missing test evidence, and unregistered changed files can fail before AI; requirements with changed files and test evidence but semantic uncertainty go to AI.

aiFallbackOrHardFailBoundaries.jsonNormalizer: Use AI repair or hard fail when required semantic fields are missing, contradictory, or cannot be normalized without changing meaning.
aiFallbackOrHardFailBoundaries.findingsAggregation: Keep findings unmerged when keys are incomplete, evidence differs materially, or severity cannot be merged safely.
aiFallbackOrHardFailBoundaries.requirementCompliancePrecheck: Send undecidable requirements to AI whenever behavior cannot be proven from diff, file-map, and test summaries alone.
